name: seated elbow chest fly on a chair
description: A seated chest fly with bent elbows that squeezes the pecs by pressing the arms together.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
